name: Cochromatic partitions of a pinned random graph
description: construct() -> partition of vertices 0..13 into nonempty lists. Every part must induce a clique or an independent set, and vertices occur exactly once. Minimize number of parts. The evaluator independently reports the exact ordinary chromatic number by subset dynamic programming. One explicit G(14,1/2) sample, generated locally with random.Random(506), is optimized. The candidate score is a cochromatic upper bound, not an asymptotic random-graph result or a guaranteed optimal partition.

sources.locator: Annika Heckel, The difference between the chromatic and the cochromatic number of a random graph (2024; revised 2025). Author abstract: defines cochromatic number by clique-or-independent color classes and studies its gap from chromatic number in G(n,1/2).
